'''Matsushita Electric''' was an electric company responsible for the creation of the [[PanaRobo]] line of [[Droid/Legends|droids]], which included the [[S-4]], [[P-6]], and [[max-W 100]] series of droids. They were a distributor to the [[Tomorrowland Starport|spaceport]] owned by the inter-galactic traveling agency [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]].<ref name="CGST" />
